subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support a separate embedded-compaction thinking level while native Codex app-server compaction intentionally ignores that setting with a warning?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and validated, but it adds a user-visible configuration option and exported shared type whose long-term product and SDK contract cannot be settled mechanically.

options.title: Sponsor the embedded-only setting
options.body: Accept `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as an optional public contract, retaining inherited behavior when unset and the documented native-Codex warning.

options.title: Defer the configuration surface
options.body: Keep current inherited thinking behavior until maintainers want to support a cross-runtime compaction-control product contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the embedded-only setting
recommendation.body: Accept `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as an optional public contract, retaining inherited behavior when unset and the documented native-Codex warning.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the maintainer rewrite and recent contract updates on this branch.
